title: Stabilize AI chat capture schema for Notion
summary: Store searchable metadata in database properties and keep the long-form session record in the Notion page body.
body_markdown:
# Overview

We converged on a Notion-first capture flow for AI chat sessions.

## Key decisions

- Use one database for v1 instead of multiple databases.
- Keep metadata in database properties.
- Let the long note live in the page body.
- Do not force fixed section names in the body.

## Why this works

This keeps the schema stable enough for filtering while preserving enough context to make the note useful later.

## Reusable lessons

- Separate search fields from narrative content.
- Prefer explicit unknown values over guessed metadata.
- Design the body format around the content instead of a rigid template.
